ios.desc:
The most simple and effective unit converter in the world.

Inché is a converter without the tedious number input.
Inché focuses on the basic units selected according to the Pareto principle.
Inché suggests an amusing way of input based on the color change.

How often do you forget how much weight in pounds is your girlfriend? How many pounds are in 100 kilograms? In these moments, it would be cool to have an app which allows converting right away instead of typing or getting lost in the settings. Inché helps you in these moments.
Whether you are used to the metric or imperial system - Inché works both ways.

Convert. Do not type.

quotes.text:
Hello, my name is Mikhail Melanin http://twitter.com/mikemockup. Together with my friend, Artyom Keydunov http://twitter.com/keydunov, we made our first app - an amusing unit converter Inché.
The app contains the primary units of measurement. The illusion of navigation is created by color change. 
The app is completely free and has no ads.

Download link to App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/app/inche/id933515910
Link to the app website: http://inche.b1nary.io
Link to the press kit: http://inche.b1nary.io/press-kit
